problem.title: Two dice
problem.statement: Roll two fair six-sided dice. Given that at least one die shows a 6, what is the probability that the sum is at least 10?

verified.method: 11 of the 36 outcomes have at least one 6. Of those, (4,6), (6,4), (5,6), (6,5), (6,6) have sum at least 10, so 5/11.
